# Ground truth as of 2026-09-02

Written after pushing 28 commits and opening PR #4 to bring `main` current. This
is the state the manuscript draft must be built from. Where a number appears
here and in a draft, this file and `NUMBERS.tsv` win.

---

## 1. The one rule

**Every reported number comes from `NUMBERS.tsv`, generated by
`generate_numbers.py` against `FINAL_BASIS_2026-08-22/`.** Validate the basis
first:

```bash
python3 freeze_basis_bp.py
```

Twelve checks, non-zero exit on any drift. `NUMBERS.tsv` annotates its own rows
with `QUOTE THIS` and `DO NOT QUOTE`. Those annotations are not advisory; they
mark the exact places where a plausible-looking number is a detection artifact.

## 2. The basis

| | |
|---|---|
| **Reported run** | 22-core workstation, `agitated_coulomb`, 2026-08-18/19 |
| **Basis** | **85 units, 2,340 genomes** (`FINAL_BASIS_2026-08-22/`) |
| **Control run** | DGX A100, `insane_jennings`, 2026-08-19, 88 units, 2,342 genomes |
| **Pipeline** | `wf-assembly-snps-mod` @ `79ab645`, tag `v1.0.5-mod` |
| **Script ID** | `e09a5c4eadba2c5984f6790095423ee4` (identical in both runs) |

The production/control designation **flipped on 2026-08-22**. The workstation run
is *reported*; the A100 run is the *cross-hardware control*. Any document calling
the 88-unit A100 run "production" predates that correction.

## 3. Numbers that are easy to get wrong

**r/m.** Four values exist because they are partition x basis. Only one is the
headline.

| value | what it is | use |
|---|---|---|
| **7.70** | Gate 1 in-window, n=47, alignment-derived, frozen basis | **QUOTE THIS** |
| 7.44 | the A100 run | no |
| 7.38 | A100 under the Mash proxy | no |
| 7.26 | frozen basis under the Mash proxy | no |
| 5.51 | median over all 85 units | **DO NOT QUOTE** — mixes measurements with detection failures |

Gate 1 is `[700, 4700]` mean pairwise core SNPs, **alignment-derived**. The Mash
proxy misplaced 22 of 85 units. Strata on the frozen basis:

| stratum | units | median r/m |
|---|---|---|
| in-window | 47 | **7.70** |
| below floor | 12 | 1.32 |
| above ceiling | 26 | 2.14 |
| outside, pooled | 38 | 1.99 |

Outside the window a low r/m is a **detection failure, not a measurement**. That
contrast is what makes Gate 1 a detection window rather than a filter.

**Attribution.** The denominator is **46 scorable** validation genomes, not 48
registered. Two carry a non-country exposure and are unattributable. The
estimator is part of every number: `CGMLST_LICHT_ATTRIBUTION.tsv` is NN-only,
while the headline lives in `GROUPING_LADDER.tsv`.

**Geography. NARROWED AND RESOLVED 2026-09-02.** Results section 8 is rewritten
and retitled "Most apparent phylogeographic signal in this collection is batch
structure". 26 of 85 units cluster by country taken alone; **6 survive the
BioProject control**, and the control removes **77% of the apparent signal**. Two
of the six clear it only barely (BioProject p = 0.060 and 0.063), so the robust
set is arguably four. The finding stays in **Paper 1** beside the detection
window; PUBLICATION_STRATEGY's recommendation to carry it into a geography paper
is inverted and Paper 2 is marked superseded. Figure 4 is the panel.

The original framing was that the defensible claim is 6 units of geography. The breakdown is 37 untestable (single-valued),
25 null, 12 confounded, 5 vacuous control, 6 geographic. The 37 single-country
units are the **untestable** stratum and must not be presented as the geographic
result: 30 of the 37 are Thailand, against Thailand being 67% of the collection.
Only 3 of 37 are single-BioProject, so they are not submitter artifacts, but that
does not make them evidence of structure.

## 4. What is verified, and how

- **Reproducibility (D1).** The end-to-end re-execution reproduces the headline
  exactly: Gate 1 = 47 units, median 7.70. One unit was lost to the Gubbins
  zero-seed bug; `rc=0` was not evidence of success there, and the Gate 1 gap was
  closed separately.
- **Cross-hardware control.** Both runs executed byte-identical pipeline code
  (same Script ID) with identical tool versions, differing only in Nextflow
  version and resource profile. Gubbins r/m agrees to 0.36% median relative
  difference across membership-matched units.
- **ClonalFrameML.** Local and A100 agree to 0.00% median relative difference in
  implied r/m, max 2.43% across the 47 in-window units, nothing above 5%. Both
  >5% outliers fall outside Gate 1, so the window independently predicts where
  CFML is numerically stable. Given the same starting tree, CFML returns
  byte-identical output on the two machines.

## 5. Known defects

**FIXED 2026-09-02, the whole dangerous-default family.** Five instances of one
shape: a default pointing at the wrong run, partition or parameter, producing a
plausible number rather than an error.

| # | where | effect |
|---|---|---|
| E0 | `phylogeography_association_bp.py` `--assignments`/`--trees` | v1 paths; joined v3 assignments to v1 trees |
| E1 | `gate1_from_alignment_bp.py` `--mash` | an 86-unit partition against the frozen 85 |
| E4 | `recomb_filtered_distances_bp.py` | hardcoded r/m table; mixed bases silently |
| **new** | `gate1_from_alignment_bp.py` bounds | **one window for two metrics: 39 units at 8.05 instead of 47 at 7.70** |
| **new** | `manuscript_numbers_bp.py` bounds | **same, in the script that populates the manuscript** |

The last two are the important ones. Neither crashed, both produced believable
numbers, and the second would have written 8.05 into the paper. Both scripts now
resolve the window from the metric in use, so the mismatch is structurally
impossible rather than a convention. **`gate1_from_alignment_bp.py` now
reproduces `GATE1_ALIGNMENT_2026-08-21.tsv` exactly with no arguments.**

**Determinism is fixed.** `clonalframe_nu_bp.py:249` now sets `-seed` **and**
`-T 1`; neither alone suffices, because multithreaded IQ-TREE is
non-deterministic regardless of seed.

**Still open:**

1. ⚠ **CORRECTED 2026-09-04. There is no `gubbins_seed` fix, and there never
   was.** Items 1 and 2 here previously said the reported run "predates the
   `gubbins_seed` fix" and were, additionally, duplicates of each other. Verified
   against the pipeline repository: no such parameter or commit exists on any
   branch, and the string `seed` has never appeared in a Gubbins module. What
   landed on 2026-08-19, the date it was attributed to, was PR #5 (CSV line
   terminators, pipe draining).

   The true position is worse and more actionable. **Gubbins 3.4.3 does expose
   `--seed`**; this pipeline never passes it, at any of its three
   `run_gubbins.py` call sites, so the zero-seed failure is **live in current
   code** rather than confined to the pinned commit. The reported run is still
   not seed-reproducible, and now neither is anything run today.

   **RESOLVED 2026-09-04.** Both parameters are on `main` (PRs #6, #7) and the
   demonstration is run: seed alone gives 5/10 identical pairs, seed plus a
   single thread gives **10/10**, at roughly 2x cost. Determinism is real but
   opt-in and single-threaded, not "by construction". See
   `DETERMINISM_DEMONSTRATION_2026-09-04.md`.

   The reported run itself is still not seed-reproducible: it predates both
   parameters, so re-running produces a different run rather than validating the
   pinned one. That part is not recoverable; say it once, plainly.
2. **E1**: `gate1_from_alignment_bp.py` defaults `--mash` to an 86-unit partition
   file. Same class as the E0 bug PR #3 fixed.
3. **PR #3's numbers** are from the 2026-08-19 tree. See
   `PR3_CORRECTIONS_2026-09-02.md`.

## 7. Provenance of this state

`main` sat at 2026-08-19 for two weeks while everything above was built on
`feat/core-shrinkage-and-itol`. 87 commits. PR #4 merges them. Until it lands,
any session branched from `main` will reproduce the pre-freeze world, which is
exactly what happened to PR #3.

Untracked by design and therefore absent from any fresh checkout:
`FINAL_PARTITION.tsv`, `FINAL_PANEL.tsv`, `GATE1_ALIGNMENT_*.tsv`,
`PHYLOGEOGRAPHY_ASSOCIATION_FROZEN_*.tsv`, `NUMBERS.tsv`. The prose describing
them is tracked; the data is not. A code-only checkout can read the freeze README
and still cannot recompute a single number from it.

## 9. The factor-sensitivity result, in one place

The single most important thing to come out of 2026-09-02:

**On r/m, only the divergent member matters, and it is already controlled.**
Every apparent r/m factor — reference source (17%), collection span (22%) —
dissolved on stratification into the divergent-member effect (max surviving
branch, r = −0.655), which Gate 1 and the clean-unit restriction already handle.
**r/m = 7.70 is robust to every factor tested.**

**On geography, every specification moves the count and none is defensible as
"the answer."** 26 with no control, 18–24 correctly specified, 6 with the
(over-adjusted) BioProject discriminant, 2 adding period. Report the range and
its mechanism.

**The asymmetry is the paper's spine.** Recombination is a measurement;
geographic structure is not resolvable in a collection assembled this way. This
is why Paper 1 leads with the measurement and folds the geography result in as a
limitation rather than a claim.
